svg.title: LionDriver V-cycle crosswalk
svg.desc: The V-cycle crosswalk: each box of the V against five standards, with how many of its work products cite each and which clauses. Work products citing each standard, of 89: ISO 26262 65, ISO 21448 29, ISO/SAE 21434 33, ISO/PAS 8800 11, ASPICE 63.
svg.text: V-cycle crosswalk: which clauses each box answers
Rows: the boxes of the V, grouped by level and side. Columns: the standards. Each cell: how many of the box's work products cite the standard, and the clauses they cite (WP-M-00 §3).
Read across a row to see how one box serves several standards; down a column to see where a standard's work sits on the V. The bar is the share of the box's work products that cite the standard.
Built from the register's clause columns. A work product citing a clause is not evidence the clause is met. Long cells are cut at two lines; the page lists every clause.

g.text: Terms: AI artificial intelligence · ASPICE Automotive SPICE, the process capability model · HWE hardware engineering process group of ASPICE (HWE.1 … HWE.4) · ISO International Organization for Standardization · MAN management process group of ASPICE (MAN.3 project, MAN.5 risk, MAN.6 measurement) ·

MLE machine learning engineering process group of ASPICE (MLE.1 … MLE.4) · PAS publicly available specification (ISO/PAS 8800 is the AI safety one) · SAE SAE International (formerly the Society of Automotive Engineers) · SEC cybersecurity engineering process group of ASPICE (SEC.1 … SEC.4) · SUP

supporting process group of ASPICE (SUP.1 quality assurance … SUP.11 machine learning data management) · SWE software engineering process group of ASPICE (SWE.1 requirements … SWE.6 qualification test) · SYS system requirement SYS-nnn of WP-S-01; also the system engineering process group of ASPICE

(SYS.1 … SYS.5) · VAL validation process of ASPICE (VAL.1) · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
